property_summary: After calling c.go with any sent amount, either the external call to the fixed target used up at least the sent Ether (so address(this).balance increased by 0 and c.balance is 0) or, if the external call failed, the owner receives any remaining Ether — in all cases c.balance == 0 and c.owner unchanged; we assert that msg.sender of C (owner) equals c.owner and c.balance is zero after calling go (owner preserved and contract holds no funds).
